items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: That band actually became the Casa Loma band, which was under Glen Gray... I wound up in New York... I went out with that band

ctx.x: Well Goldkette had a band called the Orange Blossoms, and Biagini took over that band and played cornet, not a jazz band. That band actually became the Casa Loma band, which was under Glen Gray, about 1931 or ‘32. And I wound up in New York and some © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-

band broke up and went out of New York with the Biagini band. He was playing one of the ballrooms, The Paragon I think — or that sounds like Chicago — but in New York. I went out with that band, $25 a week, 1932 or 3. ‘33 yeah. But we made it, you know.
